about: The one list of what SecuRAX can do, in plain words. The Command Center, the product website, the docs home page, the README and `./securax features` are all generated from this file by tools/features_sync.py; CI fails if any of them is out of date (fitness check features-current). Add a feature here, run `python3 tools/features_sync.py`, and it appears everywhere. Fields: open.cmd is what to type; open.path is a page on the Command Center; open.port is a local app; doc is the guide; highlight puts it on the website's front page.

features.name: Cyber range
features.what: Practise defending real-looking systems against a live red team, with scoring, judging and MITRE ATT&CK, D3FEND and ATLAS learning paths.

features.name: Crisis response kit
features.what: Step into an incident: collect evidence properly, find what is wrong, and draft the reports.

features.name: Purple-team loop
features.what: Attack your own AI channel, check that the attack was detected, and keep the evidence.

features.name: Check software before you trust it
features.what: Look inside a third-party package or file, in a sandbox, and see what a new version can do that the old one could not.

features.name: BFSI control matrix
features.what: Every Indian BFSI cyber obligation as one matrix: what applies to you, what is proven, and what to close next. Works with no file from you.

features.name: Regulator incident clock
features.what: Every applicable regulator's reporting deadline for an incident, counting down, with the drafts ready.

features.name: Regulatory gap maps
features.what: Requirement-by-requirement maps (RBI, SEBI CSCRF, NIST AI 600-1, post-quantum and more) with the evidence for each, checked on every change.

features.name: Risk register
features.what: Your risks with owners and dates, linked to the controls that treat them, with an overdue lamp.

features.name: Cockpit
features.what: One page: what is at risk, what to do next, and the trends. Lamps light only when something needs you.

features.name: AI security gateway
features.what: Every AI call is checked: personal data masked, prompt injection blocked, data kept in India when it must be, and every call logged.

features.name: Private chat
features.what: A ChatGPT-style assistant that runs through the gateway, with a private local model when the data must not leave.

features.name: Build with open models
features.what: Write and fix code with strong open models through the gateway, so no single AI subscription or its limits can stop the work.

features.name: Go back to a working version
features.what: Something broke? One command takes you back to the last version that worked; your edits and data are kept.

features.name: Encrypted backups
features.what: Backups that are encrypted, copied off the laptop, and proved to restore every quarter.

features.name: Storage that runs itself
features.what: Every source of growth has a limit; clean-ups run every six hours, and your phone hears only when space is still short.

features.name: What broke, and why
features.what: Names the service that stopped and the reason, in plain words, with the fix.

features.name: Guiding Map
features.what: Your daily cockpit for life and work: goals, check-ins and plans. Works offline, no AI needed.

features.name: Your AI history
features.what: Years of chats from Claude, ChatGPT, DeepSeek or Gemini as one private library you can search.
